acceptanceCriteria: A retained qualification runs lease writers (claim, renew, release) concurrently with non-lease mutations (ticket create, refine, complete-manual) on a store with at least 7,000 receipts, and records per-operation latency and outcome codes; no SNAPSHOT_MOVED starvation, and every refusal is a bounded named code.

A mixed-binary case runs a pre-PR-508 build (for example 32aa5a3f) and a current build against the same store concurrently; the result is recorded as either a named refusal or bounded completion, and receipt audit stays CONSISTENT/AGREES afterward.
Evidence names versions, host, store size and writer counts; unobserved cases stay NOT_RUN.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the issue 545 qualification (PR 546, 0a2807b7) and the issue 494 slice. PR 508 bounds claim starvation among lease writers, but that qualification used only lease writers on one binary. Non-lease mutations go through the store writer outside lease preparation admission, and the reporter's fleet ran a pre-508 build alongside newer ones before draining. Neither interaction is covered by a test or qualification. Related: V1-0645 (per-mutation audit cost), V1-0753 (PSR tests and macOS TMPDIR).
title: tasks: qualify claim admission against non-lease writers and mixed binaries (issue 545 follow-up)
